snippet.description:

Jepang yang segrup dengan Indonesia di Piala Asia dikabarkan menggelar uji coba lawan Vietnam demi membedah karakter permainan tim-tim Asia Tenggara.
Tapi tenang, Timnas Indonesia sendiri sudah sering bertemu Jepang, jadi sudah paham betul peta kekuatan mereka! Fokus Garuda kini dialihkan ke rival grup lainnya, yaitu tim kuat Timur Tengah, Qatar.

snippet.title: Germany's SHOCKING Move Leaves Ukraine SPEECHLESS!
snippet.description:
Germany’s military aid to Ukraine just took a strange turn: Chancellor Friedrich Merz traveled to Kyiv by train — a day after Russia warned diplomats to leave — pledged over €1 billion in military support, and then refused to say what was in it. We open the package as far as the public record allows, and then follow the money to a much bigger deal sitting quietly underneath it.

We break down what’s known and what’s deliberately hidden: the €350 million for Ukraine’s battered power grid before winter, the layered air defense and satellite comms, and the headline 1,000+ interceptor drones built specifically to kill jet-powered Shaheds — plus the “long-range” line that may mean German money buying Ukrainian-made strike weapons. Then the cost-exchange math that explains why cheap interceptors matter when a single IRIS-T missile costs near half a million dollars. And the number nobody led with: €8.5 billion in industrial agreements to co-produce drones and missiles on Ukrainian soil — which is why ten German CEOs were on that train. This is Germany shifting from handing over weapons to building them alongside Ukraine, while telling the public less and less.

What’s Germany really sending — and why keep it secret? Tell us in the comments.
